name: dogfood-b-java-e2e
description: Cypress e2e suite for the dogfood_b_java fixture (#443). Deliberately not the repo-root package.json -- see tests/test_contract_dogfood_b.py for why. No npm scripts here on purpose: cypress.config.ts is already the single, unambiguous e2e-command source (source_kind config_file). A duplicate npm-script command bucketed into the same 'e2e' category would manufacture a status:conflict this deliberately boring fixture is not meant to exercise.
